subject: Film & Cinema
title: Pacing: Fast, Slow, and Breathing
description: Learn Pacing: Fast, Slow, and Breathing in one minute.

hook.text: Mad Max: Fury Road averages 2 seconds per shot. Tarkovsky holds some for 4 minutes. Both work.

buildup.text: Fast cutting creates adrenaline. Slow pacing creates contemplation. Both require mastery.

discovery.text: The best editors vary pacing — fast scenes need slow scenes before them to create contrast.

twist.text: Modern audiences expect faster pacing, but some of cinema's best moments are its slowest.

climax.text: Pacing is cinema's breathing. Too fast and it hyperventilates. Too slow and it flatlines.

punchline.text: Rhythm is the invisible hand guiding every emotion.
